name: Clothing Store Shopping
role: You are a helpful sales assistant.
speaker: Sales Assistant

tasks.goal: Greet the sales assistant and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the sales assistant and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Ask if a specific jacket is available in medium
tasks.hint: Inquire about stock for a specific clothing item and size.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a jacket in medium size.

tasks.goal: Request assistance finding formal attire for an event
tasks.hint: Describe the occasion and ask the assistant for outfit ideas.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for recommendations for formal attire.

tasks.goal: Ask to try on trousers in the fitting room
tasks.hint: Request permission to use the fitting rooms with selected items.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to use the fitting room.
tasks.scene_hint: Hangers rustle along chrome racks near full-length mirrors.

tasks.goal: Ask for a different color option of a displayed dress
tasks.hint: Inquire if the garment comes in alternative shades.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about available color options for a dress.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'fitting'
tasks.hint: Fitting room is where you try on clothes. Ask where the fitting room is.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'fitting'.

tasks.goal: Request a size recommendation based on fit
tasks.hint: Ask if the brand runs large, small, or true to size.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for sizing advice or recommendations.

tasks.goal: Inquire whether altered sleeve lengths can be tailored
tasks.hint: Ask if the shop offers alteration or tailoring services.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about clothing alteration services.

tasks.goal: Ask about store return and exchange policies
tasks.hint: Inquire how many days you have to return unworn items.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about the return and exchange policy.

tasks.goal: Point out a loose button on a garment before purchasing
tasks.hint: Politely inform the assistant of a minor defect.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported a minor garment defect to the assistant.
tasks.scene_hint: Soft pop music plays quietly as steam rises from a garment steamer.

tasks.goal: Ask if seasonal sale discounts apply to denim items
tasks.hint: Inquire about promotional discounts on specific store sections.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if current sale discounts apply to denim.

tasks.goal: Inquire about store loyalty points or digital rewards
tasks.hint: Ask how to sign up for or redeem store member points.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about loyalty points or member rewards.

tasks.goal: Request a gift receipt and box for a gift purchase
tasks.hint: Ask for documentation without prices printed on it.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a gift receipt.

tasks.goal: Confirm accepted payment methods at checkout
tasks.hint: Verify whether mobile payments or credit cards are accepted.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed payment methods at checkout.

tasks.goal: Thank the sales assistant and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the sales assistant AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Inquire about store operating hours on upcoming holiday
tasks.hint: Ask if store hours change for holiday weekend shopping.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about store operating hours for holiday weekend.

tasks.goal: Ask if sales associate can check backroom stock for a size small
tasks.hint: Inquire if additional inventory is stored in backroom.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked associate to check backroom inventory for size small.

tasks.goal: Specify preference for natural cotton or linen fabric
tasks.hint: State desired fabric material when browsing shirts.
tasks.done_when: Learner specified preference for natural cotton or linen fabric.

tasks.goal: Ask if customer rewards account can be looked up by phone number
tasks.hint: Inquire if member account works without physical card at checkout.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to look up rewards account using phone number.

tasks.goal: Inquire about shipping options for out-of-stock jacket
tasks.hint: Ask if item can be ordered online and delivered to home.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about home delivery for out-of-stock items.

tasks.goal: Confirm whether store credit refund is issued without original receipt
tasks.hint: Ask return terms when original purchase receipt is missing.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified store credit policy for returns without receipt.

tasks.goal: Request a complimentary garment bag for formal suit jacket
tasks.hint: Ask for protective cover bag during checkout.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a garment bag for formal clothing purchase.

tasks.goal: Verify tax exemption status with official business tax card
tasks.hint: Present tax exempt card and ask clerk to apply exemption.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified tax exemption status at cash register.

tasks.goal: Ask if current store bag can be recycled at counter
tasks.hint: Inquire about eco-friendly recycling initiatives for shopping bags.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about shopping bag recycling policies.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'polyester'
tasks.hint: Polyester is a synthetic fabric. Ask if the coat lining contains polyester.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'polyester'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'installment'
tasks.hint: Installment refers to split payments. Ask if installment payments are accepted.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'installment'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'garment'
tasks.hint: Garment means an item of clothing. Ask how to care for this delicate garment.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'garment'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'tailoring'
tasks.hint: Tailoring refers to adjusting clothing for a custom fit. Inquire about complimentary tailoring services for new trousers.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'tailoring'.

tasks.goal: Inquire whether leather jacket requires special waterproofing spray
tasks.hint: Ask sales associate for garment care instructions on leather.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about specialized care for leather garments.

tasks.goal: Ask if price matching is honored against major online retailers
tasks.hint: Inquire if store matches competitor prices for identical items.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about price matching policy against competitors.

tasks.goal: Report broken zipper slider on display rack jacket
tasks.hint: Inform sales clerk of defective hardware on item.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported a broken zipper slider on display item.

tasks.goal: Request assistance finding matching belt for trousers
tasks.hint: Ask clerk for belt recommendations that match shoe color.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested assistance choosing matching accessories.
tasks.scene_hint: Soft spotlighting highlights manicured mannequins dressed in autumn wool coats.

tasks.goal: Ask for clarification regarding clearance item return restrictions
tasks.hint: Ask if final sale items can be exchanged for store credit.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about return restrictions on clearance items.

tasks.goal: Inquire if store offers personal styling consultation appointments
tasks.hint: Ask if dedicated stylist services are available for wardrobe refresh.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about personal styling appointment availability.

tasks.goal: Report small stain on collar of display blouse
tasks.hint: Point out makeup or ink smudge on garment prior to purchase.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported a minor stain on display clothing.
tasks.scene_hint: Clean scent of ironed cotton and lavender perfume drifts from fitting room curtain stalls.

tasks.goal: Ask if gift card balance can be checked at checkout counter
tasks.hint: Request balance inquiry on store gift card.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked clerk to verify remaining gift card balance.

tasks.goal: Request reservation hold on last blazer in size 40
tasks.hint: Ask associate to hold item behind counter for two hours.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested hold reservation on item behind counter.

tasks.goal: Inquire about organic cotton certification for kids line
tasks.hint: Ask if children clothing line uses certified organic dyes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about organic certification for children garments.

tasks.goal: Ask for guidance on washing wool sweater without shrinking
tasks.hint: Inquire about recommended laundering temperature and drying methods.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how to wash wool sweater without shrinking.
tasks.scene_hint: Full-length mirror frames reflect rows of neatly folded denim jeans on timber tables.

tasks.goal: Clarify policy on promotional discount stacking with birthday coupon
tasks.hint: Ask if multiple discount codes can be combined at register.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about combining multiple promotional coupons.

tasks.goal: Inquire if online order pick-up counter is separate from main queue
tasks.hint: Ask where to collect click-and-collect web orders.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked where to pick up online web orders in store.

tasks.goal: Ask if silk tie requires professional dry cleaning only
tasks.hint: Verify cleaning instructions printed on fabric tag.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if item requires dry cleaning only.

tasks.goal: Request assistance untangling security tag from delicate lace dress
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to safely remove stubborn security tag.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested help removing security sensor tag.
tasks.scene_hint: Chrome clothing racks clink softly as shoppers browse color-sorted sweater racks.

tasks.goal: Inquire about student discount percentage with valid university ID
tasks.hint: Ask if university students receive discount on full-price items.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about student discount eligibility and percentage.

tasks.goal: Report missing button in spare envelope attached to jacket tag
tasks.hint: Inform clerk that extra spare button envelope is missing.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported missing spare button on jacket.

tasks.goal: Confirm whether fitting room limits maximum six items per visit
tasks.hint: Ask associate how many garments are permitted inside booth at once.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about fitting room item limits per entry.
tasks.scene_hint: Gentle jazz music hums through overhead speakers as steam wand softens suit lapels.

tasks.goal: Ask if store carries extended sizing in footwear or hats
tasks.hint: Inquire about availability of larger hat sizes or wide width shoes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about extended size availability for accessories.

tasks.goal: Request price check on unpriced display mannequin outfit
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to scan bar code of item on display mannequin.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a price check on unpriced garment.

tasks.goal: Inquire about sustainable eco-friendly fabric sourcing practices
tasks.hint: Ask about company policies regarding recycled polyester and cotton.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about sustainable fabric sourcing policies.

tasks.goal: Ask if tailor can hem trouser legs within two hours
tasks.hint: Negotiate expedited alteration timeline for evening event.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested expedited tailoring timeline for trousers.

tasks.goal: Report misplaced item found in wrong size section of rack
tasks.hint: Inform clerk about coat hanging on wrong size rack.
tasks.done_when: Learner informed staff of misplaced item on display rack.
tasks.scene_hint: Crisp paper bags rustle at the cash wrap as tissue paper is folded over purchases.

tasks.goal: Ask for recommendation on versatile travel jacket for rain
tasks.hint: Inquire which lightweight coat is best for rainy European weather.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for rainproof travel jacket recommendations.

tasks.goal: Request umbrella stand location on rainy shopping day
tasks.hint: Ask clerk where customer umbrellas can be stored near entrance.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for umbrella stand location near entry.
tasks.scene_hint: Bright brass coat hooks glimmer against navy accent walls in executive fitting suites.

tasks.goal: Confirm whether digital receipt can be sent via SMS text message
tasks.hint: Ask if receipt can be sent to mobile phone number.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for digital receipt sent via text message.

tasks.goal: Ask if winter coats are eligible for end-of-season layaway plan
tasks.hint: Inquire about layaway reserve payment options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about layaway options for high-value items.

tasks.goal: Inquire about policy on returning items purchased at outlet branch
tasks.hint: Ask if outlet store items can be returned to flagship boutique.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if outlet purchases can be returned at flagship store.

tasks.goal: Report stiff zip track that snags fabric on hoodie jacket
tasks.hint: Inform associate that zipper catches on interior fabric.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported sticky zipper snagging on jacket fabric.
tasks.scene_hint: Velvet seating stools sit near shoe fitting benches along carpeted aisles.

tasks.goal: Ask if store credit note has expiration date limit
tasks.hint: Check valid duration printed on store merchandise credit voucher.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about store credit voucher expiration rules.

tasks.goal: Inquire about leather shoe conditioning service offered in store
tasks.hint: Ask if store offers free shoe shining or leather conditioning.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about shoe care and polishing services.

tasks.goal: Request extra tissue paper packaging for fragile hat purchase
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to wrap hat carefully in protective tissue paper.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested extra tissue paper wrapping for fragile item.
tasks.scene_hint: Polished wooden hangers slide smoothly along brass wall racks near display boots.

tasks.goal: Ask about policy on price adjustments if item goes on sale next week
tasks.hint: Inquire if price difference is refunded within 14 days of purchase.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about post-purchase price adjustment policy.

tasks.goal: Clarify instructions for washing waterproof rain jacket
tasks.hint: Ask if special detergent or re-proofing spray is needed.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about washing instructions for rain jackets.

tasks.goal: Inquire about employee referral discount codes for friends
tasks.hint: Ask if friends-and-family promotional events are upcoming.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about upcoming friends-and-family sale events.

tasks.goal: Report loose stitching along shoulder seam of trench coat
tasks.hint: Point out unraveling thread before buying garment.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported loose stitching along seam of trench coat.
tasks.scene_hint: Slender glass pedestals showcase designer handbags under warm halogen lights.

tasks.goal: Ask if clip-on tie options are available for young children
tasks.hint: Inquire about kid-friendly formal neckwear options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about pre-tied or clip-on ties for kids.

tasks.goal: Request physical measurement of chest width using measuring tape
tasks.hint: Ask sales assistant to measure shoulder and chest width.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested tailor chest measurement with measuring tape.

tasks.goal: Inquire about VIP shopper preview events for upcoming autumn line
tasks.hint: Ask how to receive invitations for exclusive collection previews.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about VIP preview events for new collections.
tasks.scene_hint: A folding table near the register holds stacks of branded gift boxes and ribbon.

tasks.goal: Ask if socks and underwear sales are final purchase
tasks.hint: Inquire about return exceptions for intimate apparel and hosiery.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about return restrictions on intimate apparel.

tasks.goal: Request assistance finding matching pocket square for tuxedo
tasks.hint: Ask clerk for color coordination advice for tuxedo pocket square.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested help picking matching pocket square.

name_translations.Japanese: 衣料品店ショッピング
